title: SetupKit: Efficient Multi-Corner Setup/Hold Time Characterization Using Bias-Enhanced Interpolation and Active Learning
problem: Accurate setup/hold time characterization relies on potentially millions of SPICE simulations across diverse process-voltage-temperature (PVT) corners, creating a major bottleneck lasting weeks or months. Existing methods suffer from slow search convergence and inefficient exploration in multi-corner settings.
motivation: To drastically reduce characterization time using statistical intelligence and active learning to intelligently guide expensive SPICE simulations to the most informative corners.
method: SetupKit integrates three key innovations: BEIRA (bias-enhanced interpolation search) from statistical error modeling to accelerate convergence; initial search interval estimation by circuit analysis; active learning strategy using Gaussian Process to learn PVT-timing correlations and guide simulations to informative corners, minimizing redundancy in multi-corner characterization.
key_novelty: Active learning approach using Gaussian Process to intelligently minimize multi-corner characterization by focusing on the most informative PVT corners.
contributions: BEIRA (bias-enhanced interpolation) method for accelerated search convergence
Active learning framework learning PVT-timing correlations
2.4× overall CPU time reduction (720→290 days on single core) for 16 PVT corners
limitations: The approach has been demonstrated on 22nm standard cells with 16 PVT corners; effectiveness on advanced nodes or more complex corner spaces remains to be validated.
